evidence.extraction: Removed exact interleaved missing QuickJS/JSC artifact warnings from the combined stdout/stderr log, then decoded the two complete JSON objects. Bundle file metadata is interned by hash; sample.bundleGraph refers to bundleGraphs.
evidence.sourceEquivalence: Browser sources, production build settings and dependency pins match measured 26476bdb431b4d61bf52104d8fbd41efb5707da2 after rebasing over CI-only main changes. Package version bumps do not enter the browser bundles.

published.method: Cold browser process/context per sample; production builds, actual loopback HTTP gzip level 9 response bodies logged by server across page, dedicated workers and service workers. No request interception, mocks, bundler-size substitution, network throttling or OS page-cache flush. Compression happens before navigation, not on the request path. Alternating revision order. Phases use server request arrival against shell submission or sandbox command banner. Web prompt and stdout are observed after terminal parsing. Sandbox has no shell prompt; its first output belongs to the auto-started dev server, not bun -e. 300ms follow-on observation. Source-map spans are attribution estimates; gzip fragments are NOT wire bytes. Default persistent filesystem and React sandbox. Headers match isolated local preview with JS/HTML/template gzip added.
